title: A Survey of Multilingual Reasoning in Language Models
best_for_zh: 想比较不同语言中的推理训练资源、方法与评测结果的读者。
one_line: A Findings EMNLP 2025 survey of multilingual reasoning methods, training resources, and evaluation benchmarks.
系统梳理语言模型跨语言推理的方法、数据资源与评测基准。
why: It makes language coverage a concrete part of reasoning-data and benchmark design rather than an afterthought.
inclusion_reason: A peer-reviewed survey that connects multilingual reasoning methods with their data resources and evaluation benchmarks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multilingual reasoning asks a language model to solve a logical task across languages, not merely to translate a final answer. The authors identify an early-stage field shaped by cross-language misalignment, bias, and limited resources for low-resource languages. This Findings EMNLP 2025 paper surveys the methods, training resources, and benchmarks needed to understand that gap; it does not introduce a new model or dataset.

The paper therefore sets a useful boundary between language coverage and reasoning coverage. A system may accept many languages while evidence exists for only a small set of tasks or resource-rich languages. Read the survey when deciding which languages and reasoning tasks an evaluation must include; it cannot by itself demonstrate equitable performance for every language community.

多语言推理要求语言模型在不同语言中完成逻辑任务，而不只是翻译最终答案。作者指出，这一领域仍处早期阶段，跨语言错配、偏差以及低资源语言的数据不足都会影响结果。论文发表于 Findings EMNLP 2025，系统整理方法、训练资源与基准，不发布新的模型或数据集。

本文区分语言覆盖与推理覆盖：系统能接受多种语言，并不等于已在多种任务或低资源语言上得到证据。它适合帮助确定评测应纳入哪些语言和推理任务，却不能单独证明对每个语言社群都表现公平。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is a structured map of multilingual reasoning research. It links motivations and foundational challenges to the data resources used for training, then to benchmark-based evaluation and reported methods. For a reader, the useful comparison is whether a claimed improvement changes the language coverage, the reasoning procedure, or only the evaluation setting.

This sequence makes the comparison concrete: resources determine what languages and examples are available, benchmarks determine what counts as success, and methods operate within both constraints. A result is easier to interpret after locating it on all three dimensions. The survey discourages treating an English-centered method name or an aggregate score as sufficient evidence of multilingual reasoning.

核心贡献是把多语言推理研究整理成一张结构化地图。论文将研究动机和基础挑战，同训练所用的数据资源、基准评测及已有方法连接起来。读者可据此区分：一项改进改变的是语言覆盖、推理过程，还是仅仅评测设置。

资源决定有哪些语言和样例可用，基准决定什么算成功，方法则受这两者约束。把结果放回这三个维度后才容易解释。本文提醒读者：英语中心的方法名称或汇总分数，都不足以证明多语言推理能力。

title: Method
方法
html:
This is a literature survey rather than a training procedure. Its inputs are existing multilingual reasoning studies, their data resources, and their benchmarks; its output is a systematic overview plus analysis of state-of-the-art methods and performance. The paper supplies no common reward model, verifier, sampling budget, codebase, or new data release, so those details must be checked in each cited primary work.

For reusable reading notes, record the languages, task formulation, training resource, benchmark, and scoring rule for every primary paper. That compact schema reflects the survey's organization and exposes missing information early. It also keeps distinct the survey's synthesis from the operational choices of the systems it summarizes, which can differ substantially even under similar labels.

这是一篇文献综述，不是训练流程。输入是已有的多语言推理研究、所用数据资源和评测基准；输出是系统概览，以及对现有方法和表现的分析。论文没有给出统一的奖励模型、验证器、采样预算、代码库或新数据发布，相关细节应回到被引用的原始工作核对。

做阅读笔记时，可为每篇原始论文记下语言、任务表述、训练资源、基准和评分规则。这个简表贴合本文的组织方式，也会及早暴露缺失信息。它还能把综述的综合结论与被总结系统各不相同的具体操作选择分开。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The evidence offered here is breadth and organization, not a new leaderboard. The official abstract says the review covers standard training resources, evaluation benchmarks, state-of-the-art methods, and their performance. It therefore helps readers locate what has been evaluated, while leaving the comparability of individual scores to the underlying studies.

Evidence should consequently be read at the level at which it was produced. A number may describe one language set, one task family, or one benchmark translation rather than multilingual reasoning in general. The survey is a reliable guide to locating comparisons, but the primary experiment remains necessary for checking language splits, prompts, and the meaning of its reported metric.

这篇论文提供的证据是覆盖范围和结构化整理，而不是新的排行榜。官方摘要说明它汇总了标准训练资源、评测基准、现有方法及其表现。因此它能帮助读者定位哪些内容已被评测；单项分数是否可直接比较，仍要查看原始研究。

证据必须按其产生层次解读。一个数字可能只描述某个语言集合、任务家族或基准翻译，而非一般性的多语言推理。本文能帮助定位比较，但语言划分、提示与指标含义仍应由原始实验确认。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The authors present this as the first in-depth review of multilingual reasoning in language models. Its new value is the joint treatment of language diversity, reasoning tasks, data resources, and benchmarks, rather than a new optimizer or model architecture. It is a strong orientation document, but it should not be read as evidence that one method dominates every language or task.

Its distinctive contribution is thus an evaluative frame, not a claimed universal solution. It makes visible where work on reasoning has relied on particular linguistic resources and where language-focused evaluation omits the reasoning task itself. That joint perspective is valuable for assessing whether a proposed advance changes the underlying problem or only a narrow experimental slice of it.

作者将其定位为首篇深入讨论语言模型多语言推理的综述。新意在于把语言多样性、推理任务、数据资源和基准放在一起考察，而不是提出新的优化器或模型结构。它适合建立全局认识，但不能据此断言某种方法在每种语言、每项任务中都更好。

其独特贡献是评价框架，而不是通用解法。它揭示推理研究何处依赖特定语言资源，也指出语言评测何处遗漏推理任务本身。由此可判断一个新结果改变了基础问题，还是只覆盖狭窄实验切片。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Results across languages can be difficult to compare because models, scripts, resources, and tasks may differ. The paper explicitly foregrounds misalignment, bias, and low-resource challenges, so an apparent aggregate gain may conceal uneven language coverage. Because it is a survey, it also cannot replace direct inspection of data provenance, prompts, and evaluation protocols in primary papers.

Do not infer that translation quality and reasoning quality fail or improve together. The survey's framing implies multiple possible bottlenecks, including the language representation, available resources, task wording, and evaluation construction. When a result is important, inspect whether it reports per-language behavior and whether low-resource languages are actually represented rather than only named in the motivation.

不同语言的结果往往难以直接比较，因为模型、书写体系、资源和任务可能不同。论文明确强调错配、偏差和低资源挑战，因此总体提升可能掩盖语言覆盖不均。作为综述，它也不能替代对原始论文中数据来源、提示和评测协议的直接检查。

不要推断翻译质量与推理质量必定同步改善或变差。表示方式、可用资源、任务措辞和评测构造都可能形成瓶颈。对重要结论，应检查是否按语言分别报告，以及低资源语言是否真的进入实验而非只出现在动机中。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this paper to frame a multilingual reasoning experiment before selecting a model or dataset. It helps turn a vague request such as “support more languages” into testable choices about languages, reasoning tasks, training resources, and benchmarks. It is especially useful when a project must include low-resource languages rather than treating English results as sufficient.

Use the map to write an evaluation specification before implementation: name the languages, define the reasoning task, identify the relevant resource, and choose the benchmark and score. This makes inclusion measurable instead of aspirational. The survey can guide a balanced reading list, but primary papers must still supply the concrete prompts, splits, and methodological details for a reproducible experiment.

在选择模型或数据集前，可用这篇论文界定多语言推理实验。它能把“支持更多语言”这样的模糊需求，变成关于语言集合、推理任务、训练资源和基准的可检验选择。若项目需要覆盖低资源语言，而非把英语结果当作充分证据，这篇论文尤其有用。

可在实现前写出评测说明：列明语言、定义推理任务、确定资源，并选定基准和分数。这会把“包容”变成可测量的要求。本文可引导均衡阅读，但可复现实验仍需原始论文给出提示、划分和方法细节。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the challenges and motivations first, then follow the paper's progression from data resources to benchmarks and method comparisons. Keep four questions visible: which languages are included, which reasoning task is tested, what resource supports training, and how is performance measured? Those questions prevent translation quality from being mistaken for reasoning ability.

Add a fifth question when following references: are results reported separately for the included languages or only in aggregate? Then compare like with like, rather than combining papers with different language sets and tasks. This reading discipline helps identify whether a claimed improvement is genuinely multilingual, a transfer observation, or a measurement artifact of the selected benchmark.

建议先读挑战与动机，再依次阅读数据资源、基准和方法比较。始终追问四件事：覆盖哪些语言、测试什么推理任务、训练依赖什么资源、如何衡量表现？这些问题能避免把翻译质量误当成推理能力。

追踪引用时再问第五件事：结果是按语言分别报告，还是只给汇总值？只比较语言集合与任务相近的研究。这样能识别所谓提升究竟是真正的多语言现象、迁移观察，还是所选基准造成的测量假象。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Akash Ghosh, Debayan Datta, Sriparna Saha, and Chirag Agarwal. 2025. A Survey of Multilingual Reasoning in Language Models. Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025, pages 8920–8936. https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-emnlp.474/

The ACL Anthology entry is the authoritative citation source for the title, authors, venue, pages, and DOI record. Cite this paper for the field overview and its organization of resources, benchmarks, methods, and challenges. Cite a primary work separately when discussing a specific multilingual dataset, system, language result, or evaluation protocol, because those details are not newly established by the survey.

Akash Ghosh、Debayan Datta、Sriparna Saha、Chirag Agarwal。2025。《A Survey of Multilingual Reasoning in Language Models》。Findings of EMNLP 2025，8920–8936 页。https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-emnlp.474/

标题、作者、会议、页码与 DOI 应以 ACL Anthology 为准。本文适合引用其对资源、基准、方法和挑战的领域整理。讨论具体多语言数据集、系统、某种语言上的结果或评测协议时，应另引相应原始工作，因为这些细节不是本文新建立的。
